records.reported_material_and_preparation: The article's Table 1 reports half a teaspoonful of fresh turmeric powder mixed with 30 ml of warm milk; it also reports inhalation of smoke from burning dried turmeric rhizome.
records.source_geographic_context: An India-focused ethnobotany review by authors at NBPGR regional stations; the table says its information was collected from the Malayalam-language book Ayirathionnu Ottamoolikal (Namboodiri, 2004). The article does not assign this particular practice to a named community or precise locality.
records.evidence_status: documented in a secondary ethnobotanical source; not a clinical or experimental efficacy result

source.title: Ethnobotany of turmeric (Curcuma longa L.)
source.underlying_reference_reported_by_article: Namboodiri. 2004. Ayirathionnu Ottamoolikal (Malayalam). Exact edition and access were not independently verified.

limitations: This is a report of a practice in literature, not evidence that the practice is safe or effective.

No specific community or exact locality is assigned to this table entry by the paper; KAPPA does not infer one.
